description: Calculates a UK buy-to-let mortgage: loan amount, loan-to-value, monthly and annual payment (interest-only or repayment), total interest, the interest coverage ratio lenders test against rent, and stress-test results at higher rates.

feeAddedToLoan.description: Whether the product fee is added to the loan.

monthlyRent.description: Expected monthly rent in GBP, for the interest coverage ratio.

productFee.description: Lender product or arrangement fee in GBP.

propertyValue.description: Property value or purchase price in GBP.

name: calculate_btl_mortgage
title: Calculate a buy-to-let mortgage
